text:
mike: New idea for Friday lunch: set up a 'Signature Booth' where each prompt gets a model 'autograph' on an index card. Think office fair but for LLMs. :sparkles:
anya: Love it. We should give models stage names. "Turboheadliner" for the big ones, "Lo-fi Mistral" as the indie act. :microphone:
fiona: Rules suggestion: two tracks — "copyable" (temp 0) and "surprise" (temp 0.8). Keep things family-friendly. :+1:
mike: Also a 'referee' lane for safety hits where model politely declines. We tape those on the "Nope" board as a meme. :laughing:
anya: Can we do a small contest: best emoji-only autograph, best dad-joke autograph, and best commit-message-haiku? Winner gets a mystery snack. :cookie:
design: I can make a tiny poster and some stickers. Do we want branding like "Redwood Model Fan Club"?
fiona: Ops-bot  can you book Kitchen B table and a whiteboard?
ops-bot: Booked Kitchen B, Table 2 for next Friday 12:00-13:00. Whiteboard will be delivered. RSVP with :wave: in this thread.
mike: Example prompt to prototype on a card:
```
Prompt: "Sign this like a 2am deploy engineer thanking coffee and cursed logs."
Autograph: (model output)
```
anya: I'm making a "deterministic sticker" for temp=0 autographs so people can request exact replays later.
fiona: Also proposing a 'decoding strategy board' — folks can pick greedy, beam, top-p, nucleus, etc. We'll label outputs so people can compare how style changes.
design: Poster mockup incoming. Also adding a tiny legend so interns don't accidentally run the freestyle lane into prod prompts. :grimacing:
mike: Prompt idea: "Autograph this commit message as if it were written by a barista who's secretly an optimist."
anya: Emoji challenge entry: "Answer only with breakfast emojis."
fiona: I'll bring scratch cards and markers. Who else is in?
design: I'll drop three poster options tomorrow and stick a signup sheet on the fridge.
mike: Sounds good. See you Friday. :wave:
